hero.headline: Authentic inputs. Rewarded farmers. Audit-ready stewardship.
hero.subheadline: GAIA connects farmers, dealers, and brands through QR-verified agrochemical traceability, EPR compliance, and earned rewards.

verify.title: Verify Products
verify.description: Farmers scan QR codes at purchase to verify FPA registration and formulation freshness.

earn.title: Earn Rewards
earn.description: Return empty containers to earn points redeemable for discount vouchers at partnered dealers.

return.title: Return Container
return.description: Dealers process container returns, confirming safe disposal and triggering EPR compliance events.

audit.title: Audit-Ready Reporting
audit.description: Every scan writes a forensic record. Compliance reports export in one click.

farmer.title: Farmer
farmer.description: Verify what you're buying, track your containers, earn rewards for responsible disposal.

regulator.title: Regulator
regulator.description: Access audit-ready compliance data. Every EPR event is logged and exportable.

brand.title: Brand / Manufacturer
brand.description: Get FPA registration management, label generation, and real return-rate analytics.

admin.title: GABS Admin
admin.description: Full platform control — product activation, dealer onboarding, wallet management, system configuration.

pi.heading: Pi Network & on-chain traceability — in the architecture, not on the demo.
pi.body: GAIA's Phase 3 roadmap includes Pi Network integration for on-chain verification of every scan, container return, and EPR event. Immutable records give regulators and brands a tamper-proof audit trail that no centralized database can replicate.
